Delays in CBSE Re-evaluation Cause Concerns for Delhi University Admissions

The delay in the re-evaluation process by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has caused concerns among students applying to Delhi University, with many fearing that their admissions may be affected. The university has assured that it is taking steps to resolve the issue, but the delay has raised questions about the fairness and efficiency of the admission process.
